span.p:
loadFromEEPROM() — check each magic byte;
write defaults if section uninitialised

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Main section (magic 0xB1):
Injection map 10×4 (uint8, 100 µs/count)
PID coefficients Kp / Ki / Kd (float32)
Pressure table: low bar, high bar, threshold RPM
IAT correction 5 × Q8.8
ET correction 5 × Q8.8

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Axis section (magic 0xB2):
RPM axis 10 × uint16
TPS axis 4 × uint8

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TPS cal section (magic 0xAD):
closed ADC count, open ADC count

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Accel pump section (magic 0xAE):
threshold %/s, extra µs, duration ms

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
initCKPS():
Timer1 normal mode, clk/8, falling-edge ICP
enable input-capture and overflow interrupts

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
initInjection():
D4 = OUTPUT, injector OFF
D13 = OUTPUT, red LED OFF

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
initPump():
D3 = OUTPUT, PWM = 0
D12 = OUTPUT, green LED OFF
